parsed.internal_thinking: Gemma is offering 1 Wood for 1 Wheat. My current hand is 1 Wood, 1 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. I need 1 Brick (טיט) and 1 Wood (עץ) and 1 Wheat (חיטה) and 1 Sheep (כבשה) to build a settlement at N37. If I accept, I will have 2 Wood and 0 Wheat. Since I am already low on Wheat and specifically need it for my next settlement, giving away my only Wheat for a second Wood (which I already have one of) doesn't help me reach my goal of settling N37. I need to find a way to get Brick, not more Wood at the expense of my Wheat. I will reject this trade to keep my Wheat for the settlement cost.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Gemma's Wood for Wheat trade. I need to keep my only Wheat for the N37 settlement. Still missing Brick.
